Cleaning
```{r}
results_cleaned_1 <- results1 %>% 
  drop_na(game_id, rusher_name, blocker_name) %>% 
  arrange(game_id, play_id, event_game_index) %>% 
  select(-rusher_won)

#results_cleaned <- results_cleaned %>%
  #left_join(outcome_summary, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "rusher_name"))

init_play_ratings_1 <- results_cleaned_1 %>%
  select(rusher_name, blocker_name) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "type", values_to = "player_name") %>%
  mutate(Player_Elo = ifelse(type == "rusher_name", 750, 1125)) %>%  
  distinct(player_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

elo_vec_1 <- setNames(init_play_ratings_1$Player_Elo, init_play_ratings_1$player_name)
```

Elo function
```{r}
#adaptive learning rate from max
adaptive_K_prov <- function(n, K_start, K_min, n_prov, n_decay) {
  k <- ifelse(
    n <= n_prov,
    K_start,
    ifelse(
      n <= n_decay,
      K_start + (K_min - K_start) * (n - n_prov) / (n_decay - n_prov),
      K_min
    )
  )
  pmax(k, K_min)
}

#updated elo function to include K and double teams
elo_step <- function(
  belo, relo, outcome_score, blocker_K, rusher_K,
  double_team, scale = 319
) {
  if (is.na(outcome_score)) return(c(b = belo, r = relo))

  blocker_bonus <- ifelse(double_team == 1, 100, 0)
  adj_belo <- belo + blocker_bonus

  #calc based on rusher win prob
  exp_rusher <- 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((adj_belo - relo) / scale))

  #rusher rewarded when they win; blocker rewarded when rusher fails
  c(
    b = belo + blocker_K * ((1 - outcome_score) - (1 - exp_rusher)), 
    r = relo + rusher_K  * ( outcome_score      -      exp_rusher)   
  )
}

get_elo <- function(id) {
  id <- as.character(id)  
  if (!id %in% names(elo_vec_1)) elo_vec_1[[id]] <- 1000
  return(elo_vec_1[[id]])
} 

```

```{r}
results_cleaned_1 <- as.data.table(results_cleaned_1)

results_cleaned_1 <- results_cleaned_1 %>%
  group_by(rusher_name) %>%
  mutate(rusher_row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(blocker_name) %>%
  mutate(blocker_row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

#compute k for rusher and blocker
results_cleaned_1 <- results_cleaned_1 %>%
  mutate(
    rusher_k = adaptive_K_prov(n = rusher_row, K_start = 20, K_min = 10, n_prov = 87, n_decay = 200),
    blocker_k = adaptive_K_prov(blocker_row, K_start = 20, K_min = 10, n_prov = 87, n_decay = 200)
  )
```


```{r}

interaction_counts_1 <- list()  # Initialize interaction count
elo_vec_1 <- setNames(init_play_ratings_1$Player_Elo, init_play_ratings_1$player_name)

elo_history_1 <- results_cleaned_1 %>%
  mutate(
    before_rusher_elo = NA_real_,
    before_blocker_elo = NA_real_,
    after_rusher_elo = NA_real_,
    after_blocker_elo = NA_real_,
    rusher_n           = rusher_row,
    blocker_n          = blocker_row
  )

for (i in seq_len(nrow(results_cleaned_1))) {
  r_id <- results_cleaned_1$rusher_name[i]
  b_id <- results_cleaned_1$blocker_name[i]
  out  <- results_cleaned_1$outcome_score[i]
  r_K  <- results_cleaned_1$rusher_k[i]
  b_K  <- results_cleaned_1$blocker_k[i]
  d_t <- results_cleaned_1$double_team[i]

  if (is.na(r_id) || is.na(b_id) || is.na(out)) next

  r_elo <- get_elo(r_id)
  b_elo <- get_elo(b_id)

  elo_history_1$before_rusher_elo[i]  <- r_elo
  elo_history_1$before_blocker_elo[i] <- b_elo

  new <- elo_step(b_elo, r_elo, outcome_score = out, blocker_K = b_K, rusher_K = r_K, double_team = d_t)

  if (!any(is.na(new))) {
  elo_vec_1[[r_id]] <- new["r"]
  elo_vec_1[[b_id]] <- new["b"]
}

  elo_history_1$after_rusher_elo[i]  <- new["r"]
  elo_history_1$after_blocker_elo[i] <- new["b"]
}

```

```{r}
#get results
elo_df_1 <- enframe(elo_vec_1, name = "player_name", value = "final_elo")

#differentiate between rushers and blockers
player_roles_1 <- results_cleaned_1 %>%
  select(rusher_name, blocker_name) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), values_to = "player_name") %>%
  mutate(role = ifelse(name == "rusher_name", "Rusher", "Blocker")) %>%
  distinct(player_name, role)

#join to get elo with annotated rusher/blocker label
elo_labeled_1 <- elo_df_1 %>%
  left_join(player_roles_1, by = "player_name") %>%
  filter(!is.na(role))

#get top 10
top_rushers_1 <- elo_labeled_1 %>%
  filter(role == "Rusher") %>%
  slice_max(final_elo, n = 12)

top_blockers_1 <- elo_labeled_1 %>%
  filter(role == "Blocker") %>%
  slice_max(final_elo, n = 12)
```

```{r}
#pivot to get elo updates per play 
elo_long_1 <- elo_history_1 %>%
  select(game_id, play_id,
         rusher_name, blocker_name,
         after_rusher_elo, after_blocker_elo,
         rusher_n, blocker_n) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(after_rusher_elo, after_blocker_elo),
    names_to = "elo_type",
    values_to = "elo"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    player_name = ifelse(elo_type == "after_rusher_elo", rusher_name, blocker_name),
    interaction_n = ifelse(elo_type == "after_rusher_elo", rusher_n, blocker_n),
    role = ifelse(elo_type == "after_rusher_elo", "Rusher", "Blocker")
  ) %>%
  select(play_id, game_id, player_name, role, interaction_n, elo) %>%
  filter(!is.na(elo))

final_elos_1 <- elo_long_1 %>%
  group_by(player_name, role) %>%
  filter(interaction_n == max(interaction_n, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Select top 10 per role based on final Elo
top_players_1 <- final_elos_1 %>%
  group_by(role) %>%
  filter(interaction_n > 200) %>% 
  slice_max(elo, n = 10) %>%
  pull(player_name)

elo_top_1 <- elo_long_1 %>%
  filter(player_name %in% top_players_1)
```

Log loss validation
```{r}
n_total <- nrow(elo_history_1)
n_train <- floor(0.8 * n_total)

train_df_1 <- elo_history_1[1:n_train, ]
test_df_1  <- elo_history_1[(n_train + 1):n_total, ]

final_rusher_elo_1 <- train_df_1 %>%
  group_by(rusher_name) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  select(rusher_name, after_rusher_elo) %>%
  rename(rusher_elo_pred = after_rusher_elo)

final_blocker_elo_1 <- train_df_1 %>%
  group_by(blocker_name) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  select(blocker_name, after_blocker_elo) %>%
  rename(blocker_elo_pred = after_blocker_elo)

test_df_1 <- test_df_1 %>%
  left_join(final_rusher_elo_1, by = "rusher_name") %>%
  left_join(final_blocker_elo_1, by = "blocker_name")

baseline_mean_1 <- mean(train_df_1$outcome_score != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
test_df_1$baseline_pred <- baseline_mean_1

scale <- 319
test_df_1$blocker_bonus <- ifelse(test_df_1$double_team == 1, 100, 0)
test_df_1$adj_belo <- test_df_1$blocker_elo_pred + test_df_1$blocker_bonus

test_df_1$rusher_win_prob <- 1 / (1 + 10^((test_df_1$adj_belo - test_df_1$rusher_elo_pred) / scale))


test_df_1$blocker_bonus <- ifelse(test_df_1$double_team == 1, 100, 0)
test_df_1$adj_belo <- test_df_1$before_blocker_elo + test_df_1$blocker_bonus

test_df_1$updating_pred <- 1 / (1 + 10^((test_df_1$adj_belo - test_df_1$before_rusher_elo) / scale))

# --- Compute MSE ---
mse_base_1         <- mean((test_df_1$baseline_pred - test_df_1$outcome_score)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
mse_elo_1          <- mean((test_df_1$rusher_win_prob - test_df_1$outcome_score)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
mse_updating_elo_1 <- mean((test_df_1$updating_pred - test_df_1$outcome_score)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Baseline MSE:", mse_base_1, "\n")
cat("ELO MSE:", mse_elo_1, "\n")
cat("Updating ELO MSE:", mse_updating_elo_1, "\n")


```


```{r}

mse_df <- tibble(
  Model = factor(c("Baseline", "ELO"),
                 levels = c("Baseline", "ELO")),
  MSE   = c(mse_base, mse_elo)
)

library(viridisLite)
custom_cols <- mako(6)
chosen_cols <- c(custom_cols[4], custom_cols[5])
names(chosen_cols) <- c("Baseline", "ELO")

ggplot(mse_df, aes(x = Model, y = MSE, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(MSE, 4)), vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = chosen_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +  # add 10% space on top
  labs(
    title = "Model Validation: MSE Comparison",
    subtitle = "Baseline vs ELO",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Squared Error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 14, color = "grey20"),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```

```{r}
data_1 <- results2 %>% 
  select(-V1) %>% 
  mutate(
    rusher_name = factor(rusher_name),
    blocker_name = factor(blocker_name),
    rusher_won = factor(rusher_won)
  ) %>% 
  select(rusher_won, rusher_name, blocker_name, double_team)

data_1 <- data_1[complete.cases(data_1), ]

y <- data_1$rusher_won

X <- model.matrix(rusher_won ~ rusher_name + blocker_name + double_team, data = data_1)[,-1]

fit_glm <- cv.glmnet(X,y,type.measure = "deviance", alpha = 0, family = "binomial")

plot(fit_glm)

min_lambda <- fit_glm$lambda.min


coef_df <- as.matrix(coef(fit_glm, s = min_lambda))

coef_df <- data.frame(
  variable = rownames(coef_df),
  coefficient = coef_df[,1],
  row.names = NULL
)


coef_df <- coef_df %>% filter(variable != "(Intercept)")


coef_df <- coef_df %>%
  mutate(
    variable = str_remove(variable, "^rusher_name"),
    variable = str_remove(variable, "^blocker_name")
  )

```

```{r}
names <- fread('../../nfl_data/Hudl IQ 2021 player roster.csv')
results <- coef_df %>% 
  left_join(names, by = c("variable" = "player_name"))

results <- results %>% 
  mutate(
    Offense = ifelse(team_position_name %in% c("Offensive Lineman", "Tight End"), TRUE, FALSE),
    Defense = ifelse(team_position_name %in% c("Defensive Lineman", "Linebacker"), TRUE, FALSE)
  )

n_interactions_rusher <- data_1 %>% 
  group_by(rusher_name) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

n_interactions_blocker <- data_1 %>% 
  group_by(blocker_name) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

qualified_rusher <- n_interactions_rusher %>% 
  filter(count > 199) %>% 
  pull(rusher_name)

qualified_blocker <- n_interactions_blocker %>% 
  filter(count > 199) %>% 
  pull(blocker_name)

best_blockers <- results %>% 
  filter(Offense==T & variable %in% qualified_blocker) %>% 
  arrange(-desc(coefficient)) %>% 
  select(variable,coefficient,player_id) %>% 
  unique()

best_rushers <- results %>% 
  filter(Defense==T & variable %in% qualified_rusher) %>% 
  arrange(desc(coefficient)) %>% 
  select(variable,coefficient,player_id) %>% 
  unique()

ggplot(best_blockers,aes(x=coefficient)) +
  geom_histogram(color="white", fill = custom_cols[4]) +
  labs(
    title = "Blocker Coefficient Distribution",
    x = "Coefficient",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 14, color = "grey20"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), 
    axis.title.y  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

ggplot(best_rushers,aes(x=coefficient)) +
  geom_histogram(color="white", fill =custom_cols[4]) +
  labs(
    title = "Rusher Coefficient Distribution",
    x = "Coefficient",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 14, color = "grey20"),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), 
    axis.title.x  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), 
  )
```
